Build an n8n community node for VNTANA’s Admin API; MVP: Products and Authentication. Use declarative JSON routing, not `execute()`. Base URL: `https://api-platform.vntana.com`; auth header `X-AUTH-TOKEN`. Auth is login → refresh-token with organizationUuid; store org-specific token in credentials. Responses: `{ success: boolean, errors: [], response: {...} }`.

MVP endpoints: GET `/v1/products/{uuid}`; POST `/v1/products/clients/search`; PUT `/v1/products`; DELETE `/v1/products/delete`; PUT `/v1/products/status`; GET `/v1/organizations`; GET `/v1/clients/client-organizations`.

Commands:
`npm run build` (`tsc && gulp build:icons`)
`npm run dev` (`tsc --watch`)
`npm run lint` (`eslint nodes credentials --ext .ts`)
`npm run lintfix`
`npm link`
`cd ~/.n8n/custom && npm link n8n-nodes-vntana`

Before asking the user to test in n8n, verify the implementation works. All new operations must have unit tests. Run tests before any manual testing. If it doesn't work with curl, it won't work with n8n. Always verify API calls work:
`curl -X POST "https://api-platform.vntana.com/v1/<endpoint>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-AUTH-TOKEN: Bearer <token>"`
Then `npm run build` and `<REDACTED_USERPATH>/GitHub/VNTANA-n8n-node/.claude/skills/n8n-relink/scripts/relink.sh`. Only after curl verification succeeds.

Always bump the version when committing changes to node code (`nodes/` or `credentials/`). Bug fixes: `npm version patch`; new operations/features: `npm version patch` or `npm version minor`; breaking API changes: `npm version major`. Test-only, docs-only, and CI/CD-only changes: no bump. Push with `git push origin main --tags`. If deferring publishing, commit changes and bump before next publish to cover all changes since last release.

GitHub repo must be public. Run scanner locally first: `npx <REDACTED_USER>/scan-community-package n8n-nodes-vntana@latest`. All code must use `httpRequest`; `this.helpers.request()` is not allowed. Publish checks: `npm run build`, version bump, push tags, then `npx <REDACTED_USER>/scan-community-package n8n-nodes-vntana@<new-version>`. For scanner cache, specify version explicitly: `<REDACTED_USER>.1.1`.

Credential test helper typing workaround:
`const helpers = this.helpers as unknown as { httpRequest: (options: object) => Promise<any> };`
Use `helpers.httpRequest({url: 'https://api.example.com/auth', body: { email, password }, returnFullResponse: true})`; NOT `resolveWithFullResponse`.

Docs: `documentation/vntana-api-docs/CLAUDE.md`, `documentation/n8n-docs/CLAUDE.md`, `documentation/vntana-api-docs/swagger/`.
